summary: All 38 recorded obligations are discharged; the exact repeat-budget identity, W bounds, W=5 weighted-triangle exclusion, and both W=6 forced isolated-support incidence conclusions are sound under the explicit actual-graph N15 hypotheses. Same-family provisional paper review only.

reviewer_backend_attestation.note: Requested or skill-target settings are not represented as observed backend metadata.

assumptions: One finite simple undirected graph on 59 vertices with maximum degree at most 8 and diameter at most 2.
B is the actual defect A^2+A-7I-J of that graph.
Every zero-triangle vertex has the exact induced-support N15 row: weights 2,2,1,1 with only the two equal-weight support edges.
The main theorem has T=7 and m=21.
